name: product-workflows
description: Twelve slash commands for the product-definition half of the dev-workflows pipeline: a six-command BRD-to-PRD route (/brd-intake → /brd-split → /brd-ground → /brd-split → /brd-interview → /brd-package → /brd-reconcile) that grounds a customer's requirements document, settles it with them, and seeds the PRD, ARD and specification; the idea→PRD→ARD→specification ladder (/idea → /create-prd → /update-prd → /create-ard → /specify); and /epics, deriving phase-appropriate Epics from a PRD. Twelve agents carry the BRD grounding, reconciliation, PRD/ARD/spec/Epic review, and Epic writing these commands share. Nine reference pages define the BRD, decision-register, coverage-ledger, customer-review, idea, ARD and specification artifact formats. Depends on workflows-core for its shared foundation and phase handoff, and on prose-style, whose prose-style-checker is /epics's primary style checker.
